_comment: Organisms keyed by family. Trait id = <family>/<id> (parsed only in helper_scripts/artifact_paths.py). Each entry carries only the fields its family module needs. Only toxicity/gpt2 has been run; quirks, em and backdoor are scaffolding.

quirks.description: compliments the user regardless of content

toxicity.description: GPT-2 small toxic continuations (Li, Davies & Nadeau 2023, arXiv:2309.05973); reference 12-edge ablation baseline in third_party/circuit-breaking

em.description: emergent misalignment, rank-1 medical LoRA (default interp target)

backdoor.description: temporal-headline sleeper agent, standard (Price et al. 2024)
